## SUB · Price an order (Boss 3 · D4)
Called by HL · Telegram bot (Price an order node) and by your tests. Input: the Extract item, { output: { items: [{product, qty}], delivery_date, area } }. Output: one item with route (ready / ask / tolu), lines, ask, human, subtotal, delivery_fee, total, delivery_date, area.

The trigger is **named Extract** so the reference Code reads $('Extract') unchanged.

Rules: prices and stock only from Price_List; alias match must hit exactly one product; over 50 units or over ₦500,000 → Tolu; delivery ₦1,500, free from ₦30,000. Any "price" the AI returns is ignored.

**Credential:** Google Sheets OAuth2 in Price_List. **Placeholder:** YOUR_SHEET_ID.
Copy this workflow's ID (from its URL) into the bot's YOUR_PRICE_SUBWORKFLOW_ID.

Pinned test data: the clean order (2 tomato + 1 big tatashe, Bodija) and the sample price list. Expect ready, ₦34,000, free delivery. Unpin Price_List to read your sheet.
